name: L'Étrange Festival
blurb: Paris genre-film festival for horror, fantasy and sci-fi cinema, with international competitions, guest filmmakers and themed retrospectives.
notes: The site's 2026 microsite (XXXIIe édition, 1-12 September 2026) just concluded when checked: the homepage shows the 'PALMARÈS 2026' (2026 winners) and thank-you copy for that edition, which ended 2026-09-12, before the research window (2026-10-05 onward). No 2027 edition (the 33rd) has been announced yet — the site has no 2027 microsite, schedule or guest page live, and French genre-film festivals of this kind do not typically confirm next-year dates this far out. Left editions empty rather than guess next year's dates. cover uses the current 2026 poster (og/hero:5), the only official key art available; it will likely be replaced once a 2027 poster is published.
